subject: English
question_text: The pie-chart below shows the percentage of a families
stimulus: household saving and expenses distributed into different categories. Describe the pie-chart in 150 words : 10  Food 25%  Clothes 13%  Educatin 22%  Electricity 5%  Transport 12&  Others 8%  Saving 15%
guide_solution: Graph & charts The pie chart shows the time allocation of Robin's daily activities. From this pie chart it is seen that Robin has to maintain the time allocation for his daily necessary activities. He spends 20% time for his study, and he also need recreation for which he spends 12% time. For playing he spends 5% time. For other types of everyday work, he spends 8% time. He goes to school everyday and stays school and home for which he spends 25% time. He also spends 30% time for sleep. In this way, in this chart we see the time allocation of Robin's daily activities. On the whole, the pie chart represents the time allocation of Robin everyday activities.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 86 — Hasan Ali Govt. High School, Chandpur

subject: English
question_text: Mobile phone is one of the wonders of modern science. It
stimulus: has added a new dimension to our way of life and to the communication system. But it can be misused by someone. Now write a dialogue between you and your friend Rahman on the merits and demerits of using mobile phone. 10 208 SSC English
guide_solution: Dialogue writing A dialogue between myself and my father about the profession I choose : Father : My dear son. How are you? Myself : I am okay, papa. How is your health? Father : I'm all right, but anxious about your future career. Myself : Why father, what is ailing you? Father : You're going to appear at the HSC exams shortly. Myself : I hope, I'll make a good result in the exams. Father : Where do you like to take your admission? Myself : Papa, I want to study at BUET on Telecommunications Engineering. Father : Why do you not like to study medical science? Myself : Papa, you know that I am weak in biology. Besides, it is a very horrible profession. Father : But it's very tough to get admission into BUET. Myself : I know, papa. There is a stiff competition in the admission test. Father : You need to study hard. Myself : Sure, papa. Some of my friends have agreed to study together. Father : Okay, dear. My prayers are always with you. Myself : Thank you, papa. → (iii) active; (e) → (ii) we should give up unpunctuality; (f) → (iii) He puts off things; (g) → (iii) the passage puts emphasis on punctuality.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 86 — Hasan Ali Govt. High School, Chandpur
